summary_en: This phase 1/2 trial tests glofitamab (with obinutuzumab pretreatment), venetoclax, and lenalidomide in people with newly diagnosed, high-risk mantle cell lymphoma. Glofitamab and obinutuzumab are given by vein (IV), and venetoclax and lenalidomide are taken by mouth; how long or how often treatment is given is not stated. The main outcome measure is not stated, but the trial is described as testing safety and effectiveness.
summary_es: Este ensayo de fase 1/2 evalúa glofitamab (con una dosis previa de obinutuzumab), venetoclax y lenalidomida en personas con linfoma de células del manto de alto riesgo recién diagnosticado. Glofitamab y obinutuzumab se administran por vena (IV), y venetoclax y lenalidomida se toman por vía oral; no se indica cuánto dura ni con qué frecuencia se administra el tratamiento. El resultado principal del estudio no se indica, pero el ensayo se describe como una prueba de la seguridad y la eficacia.
who_for: Newly diagnosed mantle cell lymphoma that needs treatment, with no prior systemic anticancer therapy
ECOG performance status of 2 or lower
High-risk features, such as blastoid or pleomorphic variant, Ki67 of 50% or higher, or TP53 mutation
Agreement to allow use of archival tumor tissue from diagnostic biopsy
not_for: Treatment with strong or moderate CYP3A inhibitors or strong CYP3A inducers within the set time before study drug
Positive hepatitis B surface antigen test at screening
Significant cardiovascular disease, such as NYHA class III or IV heart disease or recent heart attack
Pregnancy, breastfeeding, or plans to become pregnant during the study
